===Etymology 1===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*žęti}}; cognate with {{cog|cu|жѧти}}, 1sg. {{m|cu|жьмѫ}}.

====Verb====
{{ru-verb|жать|impf|pf=сжать,пожа́ть}}

# to [[press]], to [[squeeze]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''жать''' [[рука|ру́ку]]|t=shake hands}}
# {{lb|ru|sport}} to [[benchpress]], to [[lift]]
# to [[pinch]], to hurt, to be tight
#: {{uxi|ru|[[о́бувь]] '''жмёт'''|t=the shoes are tight (''too small'')|lit=the shoes '''squeeze'''}}
# to [[press out]], to [[squeeze out]]
# to oppress, to draw near
#: {{uxi|ru|[[срок|сро́ки]] '''жмут'''|t=we are reaching the deadline|lit=deadlines are '''pressing'''}}
